basis: Bile reflux affects the stomach, oesophagus or pancreas; the definition does not establish hepatobiliary injury.
Hair, retinal/cataract and dental abnormalities define the syndrome; brachydactyly occurs in 80-99%. Intellectual impairment is unquantified.
Skeletal dysplasia; cutis laxa in 5/5, global developmental delay in 4/5 and oligodontia in 1/2 support additional axes; dental evidence is limited.
Carcinoma originates in the fallopian tube, a reproductive organ outside the axes.
Advanced cataract is disease of the ocular lens.
Cutaneous mucin deposition defines this umbrella; systemic manifestations of scleromyxedema do not apply across the group.
Tumour originates in uterine smooth muscle; reproductive smooth muscle is outside the locomotor musculoskeletal axis.
Ovarian epithelial malignancy; reproductive origin does not establish endocrine dysfunction.
Combined immunodeficiency with T-cell dysfunction; pneumonia in 2/5 is a separate infection, and other organ lesions occur in only 1/5.
Congenital pulmonary arterial origin anomaly with cardiac shunting; respiratory symptoms do not establish direct airway or lung injury.
Hereditary glioma susceptibility is defined by predisposition to CNS tumours; susceptibility alone establishes no additional organ damage.
Progressive macular photoreceptor, retinal pigment epithelial and choriocapillaris atrophy causes visual loss.
Diabetes-defined peripheral or autonomic nerve injury; local nerve microangiopathy does not establish a separate cardiovascular disorder.
TBX20-associated structural atrial septal defect; additional reported anomalies are also cardiovascular.
PROM1-associated retinal degeneration with severe visual impairment; optic disc and retinal vessel changes remain within the ocular axis.
Inherited cone photoreceptor degeneration is confined to the retinal axis.
Ross River virus infection causes inflammatory polyarthritis in most symptomatic patients, approximately 80-90%; transient rash adds no skin axis.
Immune-mediated skin and oral mucosal necrosis; damaging ocular lesions are reported at 5-29%. Cytopenias may be secondary to systemic illness.
Inflammatory, usually immune-mediated spinal cord injury; motor and bladder dysfunction arise from cord damage.
Tuberculous infection directly involves the peritoneum and produces inflammatory ascites.
KBTBD13-associated nemaline myopathy directly affects skeletal muscle; weakness does not establish nerve or CNS disease.
Malignant solitary fibrous tumour originates in the peritoneum.
Inherited febrile seizure disorder; fever triggering seizures does not establish an infectious disease.
T-cell precursor leukemia affects blood and marrow; hepatic leukemic infiltration with hepatomegaly occurs in roughly 40-60%. A thymic mass is not lung involvement.
Leech infestation directly occupies nasal, pharyngeal or laryngeal mucosa, all assigned to the pulmonary axis; ingestion alone adds no gastrointestinal injury.
